home.title: Welcome back
home.subtitle: Here's where things stand today.
home.disclaimerBody: This score shows how your daily habits like exercise, weight, and smoking affect your long-term health. Any existing health conditions or checkups are used to build your monthly action plan instead of lowering this score.
home.reassessmentBody: Your recent diary entries suggest things may have changed. Retaking the assessment can refresh your risk band and plan when you are ready.
home.errorBody: Something went wrong on our end, your answers are saved.

risk.calcBody: We start with standard health data for your age and location in Malaysia and adjust it based on your daily habits. The engine uses proven medical research to convert those habits into a simple score between 10 and 100.

plan.title: Your monthly plan
plan.subtitle: Ranked by what matters most for your risk profile.

clinic.subtitle: Opens Google Maps centred on your device's location, nothing is looked up on our end.
clinic.privacyNote: Opens in a new tab, your location stays with Google Maps, not with us

diary.title: Health diary
diary.subtitle: Good days and hard days both matter here.
diary.moodInfoIntro: Pick the option that best matches today overall. There is no perfect answer.

moodInfoItems.not_great: Not great: you feel unwell, unusually tired, stressed, in pain, or your symptoms feel worse than usual.
moodInfoItems.okay: Okay: you feel stable or mixed. The day is manageable, even if it is not especially good.
moodInfoItems.good: Good: you feel well, steady, energetic enough, or better than your usual baseline.

diary.loadError: Could not load your diary entries. Please try again.
diary.saveError: Could not save your diary entry. Please try again.
diary.autoLogged: Logged automatically with today's date & time
diary.emptyMessage: Log how you're feeling today, it takes under 30 seconds.

headings.3: A little about your health history

subs.1: Three quick questions, no typing needed — used to personalise your results, never shown as raw numbers.
subs.2: These answers directly shape your personalised score.
subs.3: This won't change your score — it just helps us tailor which actions we recommend.

questions.state: Which state do you live in?
questions.smoking: Do you smoke, or have you ever smoked regularly?
questions.activity: In a typical week, how much moderate-to-vigorous activity do you get?
questions.sodium: Do you often add extra salt or soy sauce to meals, or eat processed/preserved food?
questions.fruitveg: On most days, do you eat at least 2 servings of fruit and 3 of vegetables?
questions.screening: Have you had a general health screening (blood pressure, blood glucose, cholesterol) in the past 2 years?
questions.diabetes: Have you been diagnosed with diabetes?
questions.hypertension: Have you been diagnosed with hypertension (high blood pressure)?
questions.cholesterol: Have you been diagnosed with high cholesterol?

hints.activity: Counts brisk walking, cycling, swimming and similar activity.

errors.slider: Drag the slider to answer before continuing.

onboarding.trustNote: Stays on your account — we never share it with anyone else
